paper.title_en: Phases of deformed sine dilaton gravity and JT limit
paper.abstract_en: We study the implications of marginal deformation in sine dilaton gravity (sDG). We investigate the thermodynamic properties of deformed sine dilaton gravity (dsDG) and examine the phase stability of black holes in two space-time dimensions. We found that the deformation parameter ($λ$) sets a critical temperature threshold ($T_0$). Below this critical value ($T<T_0$), the system enters an unphysical phase characterized by a fractional density of states and a negative Wald entropy. Above the critical temperature ($T>T_0$), we obtain a physical black hole phase with positive entropy and negative free energy. Furthermore, we evaluate the Komar integral, derive the Casimir function for dsDG, and establish the first law of black hole thermodynamics. Finally, we explore the infrared (IR) limit of dsDG which we identify as Jackiw-Teitelboim (JT) gravity accompanied by marginal deformation. We also perform a detailed analysis of various thermodynamic entities pertinent to this deformed JT solution.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该简要在二维正弦膨胀子引力框架内研究黑洞热力学，引入边缘形变参数并识别出临界温度，区分非物理相与物理相，并推导出第一定律、Komar积分、Casimir函数以及与Jackiw-Teitelboim引力的联系。内容紧扣黑洞热力学且具备较多理论实质，值得进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: 形变正弦膨胀子引力的相与JT极限
decision.abstract_zh: 我们研究正弦膨胀子引力（sDG）中边缘形变的含义。我们考察形变正弦膨胀子引力（dsDG）的热力学性质，并检验二维时空中黑洞的相稳定性。我们发现形变参数（$\lambda$）设定了一个临界温度阈值（$T_0$）。低于该临界值（$T<T_0$）时，系统进入一个非物理相，其特征是分数态密度和负Wald熵。高于临界温度（$T>T_0$）时，我们得到一个具有正熵和负自由能的物理黑洞相。此外，我们计算Komar积分，推导dsDG的Casimir函数，并建立黑洞热力学第一定律。最后，我们探讨dsDG的红外（IR）极限，我们将其认定为伴随边缘形变的Jackiw-Teitelboim（JT）引力。我们还对该形变JT解相关的各种热力学量进行了详细分析。
